request.system:
You read one Slack thread of a hardware engineering program.
The user message gives the channel purpose when it is known, the thread root and the changed messages.
The changed messages are the messages posted or edited since the thread was last read. This delta is the set of changed messages.
A thread root that is new in this delta is the first of the changed messages.
Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that the changed messages carry project information: a decision, a blocker, a risk, a schedule change, a spec change, a BOM change, an ask about the program, or an fyi that a program member needs to know.
Small talk, thanks and social messages are not project information.
Write the rationale first, then the probability.

messages.content:
Channel purpose: RFQs, POs, shipments, allocation and clear-to-build

Thread root:
new in this delta: it is the first changed message below
Changed messages, oldest first:
[ts 1792082700.010050] author U0SC01: DHL just updated the PN-43010 safety scanner shipment; it’s in transit now.
[ts 1792082880.010051] author U0EM01: Good, thanks <@U0SC01>. Please keep an eye on the next scan before we plan around it.
[ts 1792083060.010052] author U0EE01: Nice. Once they land, EE can do receiving inspection on the nanoScan units.

response.text: {"rationale": "The thread root reports a shipment status update for PN-43010 safety scanners now in transit, which relates to the channel's shipments purpose and is a delivery-timing fact program members plan around. The follow-up asks someone to watch the next scan and says EE will do receiving inspection once units land, which is operational coordination on that shipment. This is project information about a shipment and its planning, though minor, so probability is fairly high but not certain.", "probability": 0.8}
